whatItFakes: Only full people who know a candidate offer to help once word of the filing reaches them; the counted population never offers, so a candidate's volunteers from the wider town come only from the campaign's own asks.
why: Volunteers are kept as person ids on the campaign row and an offer is a scene with a person; a counted group has no one to stage. The ask to volunteer has the same limit.
replacement: Dropped Nov 10, 2026 (too in depth, owner): the estimate stays as the game's answer. Was: Counted groups who hear of a filing offer by the same volunteerReason times their count, filled in as full people when one offers to the player.
resolvedBy: stand-in triage T9 (owner, Nov 10: too in depth)

whatItFakes: Someone close who runs a campaign is on its staff, cast as its team in scenes and the one who comes to canvass on election morning, but the campaign runs the same with or without them: the calls, the money and the volunteers' hours do not change.
why: The owner asked for the manager as someone you know (Oct 27); what a local campaign's manager changes has not been researched, and no number may be typed for it.
replacement: Research what a local campaign's manager changes (follow-up calls, the volunteers' hours organized, the calendar kept) and have the campaign engine read staffIds where it decides those.

whatItFakes: A volunteer's evening of doors for a campaign the player's circle is in is kept as a volunteer-shift event (the volunteer, the candidate, whether it was their first evening, the hours, the doors knocked, the full people met and the counted residents reached), on their first evening and then at most once a week (volunteerShiftEventDays), that no scene, journal line or screen reads yet; the player sees their volunteers' work only in the voters it moved and the campaign's door count.
why: The campaigns engine writes the record; the director and the English banks belong to the Words session, which this change may not edit.
replacement: Resolved Nov 10 (stand-in triage): a journal row (src/director/data/journal-rows.json, kindPrefix event:volunteer-shift) and a director cause (src/director/data/director.json, eventKind volunteer-shift) read the event, worded by data/english/parts/journal.json (commit 09a28996). The marker and api.stopgap call remain at src/core2/modules/campaigns.ts:2824. Was: A director situation type (Words session) reading volunteer-shift events by id: a volunteer reporting back on their evening of doors, or the week's journal line of what the campaign's volunteers walked, with the volunteer-door causes that name the volunteer as actor.

whatItFakes: A volunteer joining a campaign is kept as a campaign-volunteer-joined record (the volunteer, the candidate, how they came and the ask or filing record that brought them), and one whose reasons have weakened past giving evenings as a campaign-volunteer-lapsed record (the cause that weakened them: work hours, a cooled liking or a lost closeness), that no scene, journal line or screen reads yet; the player sees a campaign's volunteers only in the door count.
why: The campaigns engine writes the records; the director's listener scene and its English banks belong to the Words session, which this change may not edit.
replacement: The director's listener scene reading the join record by id (scene-listener-offers-to-work) and a journal line for the lapse record, both Words-session work.
